description: This file is a Bash shell script that manages the creation, deletion, and configuration of a Kubernetes cluster using 'kind'. It includes functions for container engine detection, argument parsing, and cluster management, with sections for prerequisites, cluster creation, deletion, and status checks.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints error messages categorized as '[ERROR]' and exits

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help usage information for the script

methods.name: provider_installed
methods.description: Checks if a container provider command (docker/podman) is installed

methods.name: provider_responsive
methods.description: Checks if a container provider daemon is responsive

methods.name: detect_provider
methods.description: Detects which container engine (docker or podman) is installed and responsive
